2608.05054.title: MarsCast: Transfer Learning of AI Weather Foundation Models to Planetary Atmospheres
2608.05054.paper_summary: We investigate the transferability of Earth weather foundation models to planetary atmospheres by adapting the GraphCast graph neural weather forecasting model to Mars. While GraphCast achieves state-of-the-art performance for terrestrial forecasting, its applicability to non-Earth environments remains unexplored. Using the Mars Climate Database (MCD), which provides global atmospheric fields across vertical altitude levels (similar to Earth pressure levels), we evaluate zero-shot and fine-tuned GraphCast predictions of Martian temperature and wind fields. Zero-shot forecasts produce a surprisingly accurate depiction of current conditions but fail to reproduce diurnal variability and rapidly decay toward climatological mean states. To address this limitation, we fine-tune GraphCast using MCD variables and top-of-atmosphere solar radiation forcing while holding humidity constant. Fine-tuning enables rapid learning of Martian thermal variability. Within as few as 10 training epochs, the model begins to capture the diurnal cycle and forecasts up to 10 days reproduce seasonal and vertical temperature structure. Prediction quality improves with training sample size and exhibits sensitivity to seasonal initialization. These results demonstrate that Earth-trained AI weather models can be adapted to simulate Martian atmospheric dynamics, providing a pathway toward rapid planetary weather prediction to support mission operations, dust storm risk mitigation, and future human exploration.
2608.05054.paper_summary_zh: 我們通過將 GraphCast 圖神經天氣預測模型調整到火星，來研究地球天氣基礎模型對行星大氣的可轉移性。雖然 GraphCast 在地面預測中達到了最先進的性能，但其在非地球環境中的適用性仍未被探索。利用火星氣候數據庫 (MCD)，該數據庫提供了不同垂直高度層次的全球大氣場（類似於地球的壓力層次），我們評估了 GraphCast 對火星溫度和風場的零樣本和微調預測。零樣本預測驚人地準確地描繪了當前條件，但未能重現日變率，並迅速衰減至氣候學平均狀態。為了解決這一限制，我們使用 MCD 變量和大氣頂部的太陽輻射強迫對 GraphCast 進行微調，同時保持濕度不變。微調使得火星熱變率的快速學習成為可能。在短短 10 次訓練週期內，模型開始捕捉日循環，並且預測最多 10 天的結果重現了季節性和垂直溫度結構。預測質量隨著訓練樣本大小的增加而改善，並對季節初始化表現出敏感性。這些結果表明，經過地球訓練的 AI 天氣模型可以被調整以模擬火星大氣動力學，為快速行星天氣預測提供了一條途徑，以支持任務運營、減輕沙塵暴風險和未來的人類探索。
